tasks.label: Build GanyanZekası Debug APK
tasks.command: $temurinRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Temurin'; $jdk = Get-ChildItem -Path $temurinRoot -Directory -Filter 'jdk-21*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($jdk) { $env:JAVA_HOME = $jdk.FullName } else { $env:JAVA_HOME = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Android\Android Studio\jbr' }; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin\java.exe'))) { throw 'Install JDK 21 or Android Studio to build the APK.' }; $env:PATH = (Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin') + ';' + $env:PATH; if (-not $env:ANDROID_HOME) { $env:ANDROID_HOME = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk' }; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME; npm.cmd run android:sync; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; exit $LASTEXITCODE
